declaration.preface:
Novopor is committed to embedding sustainability into every aspect of its procurement practices to minimize environmental impact, uphold ethical standards, and promote social responsibility. Our procurement strategy is designed to ensure that all sourced materials, products, and services align with globally recognized best practices in sustainability. This includes prioritizing suppliers who adhere to ethical labor practices, environmental stewardship, and responsible sourcing methods.

By implementing this policy, we aim to foster a transparent and accountable supply chain that supports our broader sustainability objectives. We actively engage with suppliers to encourage continuous improvement, reduce waste, lower carbon footprints, and enhance the overall sustainability of our operations. Through responsible procurement, we strive to create long-term value for our business, stakeholders, and the communities in which we operate.
declaration.declaration: At Novopor, we are We are dedicated to embedding sustainability into our procurement practices by maintaining the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and social responsibility. We understand the vital role our supply chain plays in creating positive environmental and social impact. Through fair, transparent, and responsible sourcing, we strive to build long-term partnerships founded on trust, accountability, and a shared commitment to sustainability. Our Commitment is reflected in the following key areas:
declaration.scope: This Sustainable Procurement Policy applies to all employees, contractors, suppliers, business partners, and stakeholders associated with Novopor Operations. It is applicable to all site locations:

Reducing Environmental Impact: We prioritize resource efficiency, waste reduction, and the adoption of eco-friendly materials and technologies. Our goal is to minimize carbon emissions, conserve natural resources, and promote circular economy principles. Employees, suppliers, and stakeholders are expected to comply with environmental regulations and contribute to sustainability initiatives.

Supplier Evaluation & ESG Assessment: Implement a sustainability scorecard to assess suppliers based on environmental and social performance. Conduct regular on-site ESG audits and require suppliers to complete self-assessments to ensure compliance with sustainability standards.
Enhancing Circular Economy Practices: We prioritize the use of recyclable, biodegradable, and sustainable materials while encouraging reuse and responsible disposal. Our commitment extends to working with suppliers and partners who align with circular economy principles, reducing environmental impact, and fostering innovation in sustainable production.
Sustainable Innovation: Novopor prioritizes sustainable innovation by developing and promoting eco-friendly products and processes. We invest in research and development to reduce environmental impact, enhance product efficiency, and support green technologies. Suppliers and partners are encouraged to align with our sustainability-driven approach to innovation.

Collaboration for Sustainable Innovation: Partner with suppliers to co-develop innovative and eco-friendly solutions for product design, manufacturing, and packaging, driving sustainability across the supply chain.
Social Practices: Novopor is committed to ensuring that all suppliers uphold fair labor practices, human rights, and ethical working conditions. We require compliance with international labor standards, including fair wages, safe working environments, non-discrimination, and the elimination of child and forced labor. Regular audits, training programs, and grievance mechanisms are in place to ensure suppliers maintain these social responsibilities.
Training & Capacity Building: Offer targeted sustainability training programs and workshops to suppliers, equipping them with best practices to enhance their environmental and social responsibility.

Sustainability Incentives & Compliance Oversight: Introduce incentive programs to reward suppliers with strong sustainability practices while enforcing strict compliance monitoring to ensure adherence to ethical and environmental standards.
Stakeholder Communication & Engagement: Foster transparent dialogue with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring continuous improvement and alignment with global sustainability objectives.

policy.monitoring:
To uphold the effectiveness of Novopor’s Sustainable Procurement Policy, a structured monitoring and reporting framework is crucial.

Conduct annual sustainability audits on key suppliers.

Require suppliers to submit sustainability performance reports annually.

Publish a yearly sustainability report highlighting progress towards procurement targets.

Use key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess compliance and impact.

The Policy is publicly available on Novopor’s website and shared through various stakeholder communication channels.

Employees are kept informed of updates and expected to integrate these practices into their work.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Sustainability Manager is responsible for managing the implementation and periodic review of this policy. This policy will be reviewed annually to ensure its effectiveness and alignment with evolving regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and organizational commitments. Any necessary updates or modifications will be communicated to all stakeholders, incorporating operational or regulatory changes and addressing emerging challenges.
